description: Unit tests for the ReportSender component in Chromium's net/url_request module, including mock jobs, network delegate, and various test cases for sending reports, handling errors, and request cleanup.

classes.name: MockServerErrorJob
classes.description: A URLRequestJob that simulates a server returning HTTP 500 Internal Server Error.

classes.name: MockServerErrorJobInterceptor
classes.description: A URLRequestInterceptor that intercepts requests and returns MockServerErrorJob.

classes.name: TestReportSenderNetworkDelegate
classes.description: A custom NetworkDelegateImpl that tracks requests, checks uploaded data, and allows setting callbacks for request destruction.

classes.name: ReportSenderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing ReportSender behavior, including setup of network environment and utility methods.

methods.name: MarkURLRequestDestroyed
methods.description: Callback to mark a URLRequest as destroyed.

methods.name: CheckUploadData
methods.description: Verifies that the uploaded data in a request matches expected reports.

methods.name: ErrorCallback
methods.description: Handles a report with a network error, sets called to true.

methods.name: ServerErrorResponseCallback
methods.description: Handles a report with a server error response, sets called to true.

methods.name: SuccessCallback
methods.description: Marks a successful request as completed.
